{
  "title": "Child Development Impact",
  "subtitle": "Comparing baseline to endline physical metrics by location and coach",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Children Tracked",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT \"Child ID\" FROM baseline UNION SELECT \"Child ID\" FROM endline) t",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Height Gain (cm)",

      "unit": "cm"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Sit-ups Gain",
      "sql": "SELECT ROUND(AVG(gain), 1) AS n FROM (SELECT b.\"Child ID\", b.\"Sit ups\" - e.\"Sit ups\" AS gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\") t",
      "unit": "reps"
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Shuttle Run Improvement (sec)",
      "sql": "SELECT ROUND(AVG(gain), 1) AS n FROM (SELECT b.\"Child ID\", b.\"Shuttle run sec\" - e.\"Shuttle run sec\" AS gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\") t",
      "unit": "sec"
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Avg Height Gain by Location",
      "sql": "SELECT b.\"Location\", ROUND(AVG(b.\"Height cm\" - e.\"Height cm\"), 1) AS avg_gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10",
      "x": "Location",
      "y": ["avg_gain"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Avg Sit-ups Gain by Coach",
      "sql": "SELECT b.\"Coach\", ROUND(AVG(b.\"Sit ups\" - e.\"Sit ups\"), 1) AS avg_gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b.\"Child ID\" = e.\"Child ID\" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10",
      "x": "Coach",
      "y": ["avg_gain"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p7",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Top 10 Locations by Overall Improvement",

On average, participants showed a height increase of {{p2}} and improved their sit-up count by {{p3}}. Faster shuttle run times indicated better agility, with an average improvement of {{p4}} seconds.\n\nWhen analyzing by location, the top performers in height growth were led by {{p5.0}} with an average gain of {{p5.1}} cm. For core strength, Coach {{p6.0}} achieved the highest average sit-up improvement of {{p6.1}} reps among their students.\n\nThe table below details the top 10 locations by height gain, providing a comprehensive view of regional performance across all three key metrics."
}
